title: feat(study): sort the list view by shirt number or by name
body:
**Size:** M

Study's list view always runs in shirt-number order (`studyRows` in `lib/studyView.ts`). Add a two-way sort above the list: shirt number (the default) or name.

### Work

- [ ] The sort in `lib/studyView.ts`, pure, with tests
- [ ] A two-option control above the list in `app/team/[squadId]/study.tsx`, beside the grid/list toggle
- [ ] Persist the choice in `stores/progress.ts`, next to `studyView`
- [ ] About's "What is stored on your device" list counts the new preference

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both sorts work in grid and list, with Hide names on and off
- [ ] The choice survives an app restart
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
source: synthetic; reworded 2026-10-24 for the new main pin (Study already sorts by shirt number, always; there is no SegmentedControl)
why: An M feature with no docs on clean main: it stays in place (only L and XL get a worktree) and starts with brainstorming.
